summary: 23 of 33 acceptance criteria are satisfied. Phases 1-3 (Core Infrastructure, Container Lifecycle, Pipeline Orchestration) are fully implemented with comprehensive code and tests. Phase 4 (HITL) is mostly complete (4/5). Phases 5-7 (Gateway Integration, CLI/Deployment, Webhooks/Extensibility) have significant gaps with 9 missing files/modules specified in the contract.
feedback:
The following 10 acceptance criteria are NOT met:

[AC-17] TASK-4-2: sandbox/egg_lib/hitl_mode.py does not exist. No HITL sandbox mode module for displaying pending decisions to humans.

[AC-21] TASK-5-1: gateway/orchestrator_api.py does not exist. No orchestrator callback endpoint in the gateway for forwarding phase completion signals.

[AC-22] TASK-5-2: orchestrator/session_coordinator.py does not exist. Session token coordination between orchestrator and gateway is handled ad-hoc in gateway_client.py but lacks a dedicated module as specified.

[AC-24] TASK-5-4: Gateway health endpoint does not report orchestrator connectivity. The /api/v1/health endpoint in gateway.py returns generic status but does not check or report orchestrator component health.

[AC-27] TASK-6-3: sandbox/egg_lib/orchestrator_client.py does not exist. No typed API client library for sandbox-to-orchestrator communication.

[AC-28] TASK-6-4: sandbox/entrypoint.py has no orchestrator mode detection. The entrypoint does not detect orchestrator mode or report completion on exit.

[AC-29] TASK-6-5: shared/egg_orchestrator/ package does not exist. No shared orchestrator package available in containers.

[AC-31] TASK-7-2: orchestrator/auth.py does not exist. Webhook endpoint has GitHub signature verification but no general bearer token authentication for API endpoints.

[AC-32] TASK-7-3: shared/egg_config/configs/orchestrator.py does not exist. No configuration module for remote orchestrator URL.

[AC-33] TASK-7-4: docs/architecture/orchestrator.md does not exist. No architecture documentation describing local, remote-single, and distributed deployment modes.

Note: The contract marks all 33 tasks and 7 phases as 'pending' despite substantial implementation existing. The contract state should be updated to reflect actual progress (Phases 1-3 complete, Phase 4 mostly complete).
